childNodes.textContent: Members may create their own databases
A personal database only its owner (and admins) sees.
Members may add databases for the whole lab
Otherwise only admins add lab databases, and members share theirs through an admin.
Members may keep a copy of the lab on their computers
The desktop app keeps a copy of the whole database, refreshed daily, as a backup. Admins always may; a laptop with a copy holds every record.
A token lets a script, a balance or another tool read the lab's records, or change them, as that person. Admins always may.
Admins may always do all of these. Everyone sees every lab database's records; each person edits what they own, and shared cages are everyone's.
Where the lab is kept, and the computers that keep a copy of it.
Which device holds the lab: the lab server, or a computer that shares its lab. Hand it to another computer, or open the lab in this window.
Copies of the lab on your computers

The BioManager desktop app can keep a copy of this whole database, refreshed every day while it's open,
        so the lab's records survive even if this server doesn't. Make a key for each computer, then enter it in the
